items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Duke’s band was another think, the Duke for harmony I guess. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and creativity.

ctx.x: Was the Basie group a standard for your guys to listen to? I mean was it—
Well for swinging, yeah. I mean Duke’s band was another think, the Duke for harmony I guess.
